title: Aeson TAH System - Post-Market Clinical Follow-up Study
official: Evaluation of the Aeson® Total Artificial Heart (TAH) System in a Post-Market Approval Setting
summary: The safety and performance of the Aeson TAH system have been demonstrated for the CE mark approval in December 2020. The purpose of this post-market clinical investigation is to confirm the safety, performance and effectiveness of the Aeson TAH system when used in routine care by surgeons.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient is intended to receive an Aeson TAH system according to the IFU indications within standard medical practice
* Patient has provided written informed consent using the Ethics Committee approved consent form

Non-inclusion Criteria:

* Vulnerable populations who could not voluntarily consent to participate in the study
